atoms.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3_2025'>I started doing volunteer work, because I wanted to learn new things. There are some skills that you can practice better outside of school than in a classroom. Therefore, I became a fundraiser for a wildlife conservation organization that aims to save endangered species. There I learned about the entire fundraising process including planning, communication and finances. I already became more empathetic, understanding and resilient through the volunteer work.</voice>

b: ++She volunteers at a wildlife conservation organization that aims to save endangered species.
She volunteers at an animal shelter for injured animals.
She volunteers at an environmental protection organisation that aims to save endangered plants.

atoms.a: What did she learn as a fundraiser?
b: ++planning, communication and finances
teamwork, time management and leadership
problem solving and having a positive attitude

atoms.a: Did she change because of her volunteer work?
b: ++Yes, she became more empathetic, understanding and resilient.
Yes, she became more arrogant, selfish and rude.
No, she didn't change at all.

atoms.a: Why does she do volunteer work?
b: ++She wanted to learn new skills.
She wanted to have fun.
She wanted to protect the wildlife.

atoms.a: How does she feel about her volunteer work?
b: ++She is happy because of her volunteer work.
She regrets doing volunteer work.

instruction.text: Höre zu und beantworte anschließend die Fragen.

hint.text:
college application – Hochschulbewerbung
to tutor – Nachhilfeunterricht geben
in hindsight – im Nachhinein
hint.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3_2025'>college application</voice> bedeutet Hochschulbewerbung. <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3_2025'>to tutor</voice> bedeutet Nachhilfeunterricht geben <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3_2025'>in hindsight </voice> bedeutet im Nachhinein.

atoms.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2_2025'>I do volunteer work, because I want to improve my college application. There is one specific college I have in mind that I really want to attend after graduating from school. Therefore, I looked for a way to increase my chances to getting accepted besides having good grades. And I found out that it looks good on a college application to do volunteer work. Hence, I decided to tutor students that need help with doing homework and preparing for exams. In hindsight, I'm really happy to be a tutor. It is a joyful activity since I get to meet a few of the younger students at my school. Moreover, it always makes me proud to see them improve at exams through my help.</voice>

atoms.a: What does he do as a volunteer?
b: ++He does volunteer work as a tutor.
He does volunteer work as a swimming instructor.
He doesn't do volunteer work.

atoms.a: Why does he do volunteer work?
b: ++He does volunteer work because he wants to improve his college application.
He does volunteer work because he wants to get better grades at school.
He does volunteer work because his parents want him to do so.

atoms.a: Does he like being a tutor?
b: ++He enjoys being a tutor because he can meet younger students at his school and help them improve at exams.
He hates being a tutor because teaching is difficult, and he doesn't like the younger students at his school.
He thinks it's okay to be a tutor, but isn't particularly enthusiastic either.

atoms.a: What does he think about college?
b: ++He has a dream college, which is why he wants to increase his chances of getting accepted.
He doesn't know if he wants to attend college after graduating from high school.
He is convinced that his dream college will definitely accept him if his grades are good enough.
